question: Which of the following planets has no satellite of its own?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mercury.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mercury planet has no satellite of its own.​**
 
• **Venus and the planet Mercury **are the only two planets that don't have a single natural moon orbiting them. 
 
• Mercury is the first planet from the sun in the solar system as well as the smallest planet among the eight planets.
